item.title: [REDACTED] The Musical!
item.description: a tuning fork that makes people break into song and dance.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Comedy

Elevator Pitch: whenever the SCP is used, anyone that hears the tuning will immediately break into a song and dance number akin to that of a Broadway performance.

Central Narrative: none

Hook/Attention-Grabber: this SCP causes anyone who hears it to break into song and dance, and anyone who hears someone singing while under this affect will become part of the performance. While under this effect subjects with terrible singing voices will suddenly gain perfect pitch, people who can't dance or are out of shape will suddenly be able to perform movements and gymnastic techniques that would require years of training and months of intense choreography to perform, subjects with no instrument playing experience will suddenly be able to play musical instruments at an expert level. No one will realize this effect is happening until the performance is over.

Additional Notes:I'm not sure if this SCP would be classified as a joke SCP or just a funny SCP. there's also going to be a list of songs created by this SCP which are mostly SCP parodies of famous musical songs, such as;

  • It's a D-Class life (It's a hard knock life from Annie)
  • Defying Human Rights (Defying Gravity from Wicked)
  • Send in the Keter (Send in the Clowns from A Little Night Music)
  • The Sound of Science (The Sound of Music)
  • Ya Got a Breach (Ya Got Trouble from The Music Man)
  • If I were an O5 (If I were a Rich Man from Fiddler on the Roof)

and I just want to make sure, would I also need to include lyrics for these songs, I'm pretty sure I would, but I just want to be sure.

item.title: Double Edged
item.description: A scp that takes the concept of a double edged sword literally
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP-#### is a European claymore originated from Scotland. The blade worke the following way:

  • The blade can be used however the wielder wants to use it for (for battle, chopping things, even things you’d normally wouldn’t use a sword for)
  • Whatever the blade is used for will always be as the iser desires the outcome to be
  • However after its use something terrible of equal or greater intensity will happen that will affect the user in some way or form.

Central Narrative: Along with the sword a journal would be found talking about its creation and its uses, such as a major example the sword being uses by a celt who used the blade to kill an entire army only for a plague to befall his village originating from the corpses that killed the same amount of people the warrior killed. (An additional note, i had a idea for one test proposal being to use the blade to kill SCP-682 but is denied cause if the blade could kill the lizard the concept of what price they’d have to pay in exchange is too grand of a hazard as it could lead to a XK-Class end of the world scenario)

Hook/Attention Grabber: the concept of gaining something for a terrible price is a unique concept that has not been explored much in the foundation and i figured it would be interesting especially considering how the saying “Double Edged Sword” is being used literally.

Additional Notes: I’m hoping for advice on how to improve the concept and make it more interesting for the reader

item.title: Dr. Eates Proposal
item.content:encoded:
I will not pretend that this article is any sort of pioneering effort into the world of philosophy in SCPs, but rather it represents my sincere and personal wish for all of us, myself included, to continue to seek balance and to challenge our preconceptions. We must learn to find The Middle Way and walk the liminal path between the order and chaos of the world around us.

There are many aspects of this piece I have chosen not to comment on and clarify in this post. This is not to say that I would not talk about them but rather I think the piece as a whole is better served by being left open-ended. I am eager to see how the journey is perceived by those with other perspectives.

Thank you for all of your readership in the two years I have been posting my works to the wiki. I have so much more I want to share and I only now feel as if I have learned how to walk in between the legs of these literary giants that I am privileged to share the space with. This is the most important thing I have ever written and I couldnt feel better about taking the risk to share it with you.

An special thank you to users LordStonefish , plaidypus, Quadraginta, and Dysadron who all provided critical feedback on the finished draft and helped me realize a much more rounded final product. An additional thanks to MalyceGraves for their help in brainstorming for the long game over the many months it took me to arrive to this destination.

LITERARY ATTRIBUTIONS
Thank you

The quote, "Church is a hospital for sinners", is attributed to St. Augustine of Hippo, John Chrysostom, and Abigail Van Buren, among others.

The quote "They shall beat their swords to plowshares" is Biblical, Isaiah 2:3-4

item.title: The Phantom
item.description: A cat-like apparition that consumes souls.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout: Class, containment procedures, a professional description of the SCP and what it does, followed by three incident reports.

Elevator Pitch: Put simply, SCP-XXXX is a cat-like apparition which consumes souls. It once had intangibility (Which it lost during an incident), and it can shield itself from all wavelengths of light, rendering itself invisible for a short duration.

It’s a hunter, so it stalks any kind of prey which catches its interest, though it prefers humans. It will stalk its target, memorizing all of its routines, mannerisms, and daily patterns in extreme detail. When they are at a point of vulnerability (Provided SCP-XXXX hasn’t lost interest) it will consume their soul.

After a large amount of souls are consumed, it exhales them into the form of a polychromatic sphere, which it then carries to an unidentifiable and unspecified location.

That’s how it’s going to be written, but in actuality, SCP-XXXX is bringing the sphere to a GOI (Of my creation) so they can use it to prevent some kind of cataclysmic event from occurring. The Foundation is unaware of this, and all they know is that whenever they try to take the sphere away from the SCP, several events occur:

  1. SCP-XXXX becomes extremely agitated.
  2. People start disappearing from the Foundation (They’re actually being dragged away by a hand of the SCP which actually causes the cataclysmic event.)
  3. Emergence of multiple anomalous entities appearing all over the world.
  4. Cataclysmic event occurs.

Central Narrative: It’s a question of morals. The Foundation has to escort SCP outside after it creates the sphere (Which can even be a problem at times), but each time it’s outside it also does what it wants, and consumes even more souls. Even though the SCP’s job is presumably important, is it morally correct for the Foundation to just let it go around killing people?

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Since the SCP has lost its intangibility and is now at odds with the Foundation, this prompts it to use its superior intelligence to resist and counteract any new containment procedures that the Foundation tries to come up with.

Additional Notes: Last time I left out a lot of details, since I was trying to summarize way too much. Hopefully this is a good balance of things. Once again, any advice is highly appreciated, and thanks in advance.

item.title: Out of One Voice (Seeking Greenlight)
item.description: The Duality of mask-based authority.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Tale

Genre (Optional): Thriller

Page Layout (Optional): The meat of the tale told from the POV of SCP-035. Followed by a revision of the SCP-035 article.

Elevator Pitch: A chance meeting of SCP-035 and Di Molte Voci.

Central Narrative:
Inside
Collapsed for mobile viewing

035 moves through a site, having inadvertently broken containment by the breach of another SCP. As it searches for a new host, 035 comes across a standard locker, that even with its telepathic abilities and photographic memory, it does not know what lies inside. Out of curiosity it checks.

035 notices the obvious connection, both being masks, and searches for the document that goes into more detail of Di Molte Voci, and finds nothing but Doctor's notes, as per the properties of DMV.

As it searches, 035 realizes that its ever-present corrosion effect, has ceased, and is fact slowly reversing. The fluid seeping back into the eyes and mouth of the mask. The host is also reverted, slowly healed of all damage done through the corrosion. SCP-035 realizes the implications of that, and is now entirely focused on DMV. It checks for any influence it may have over DMV via its compulsions and finds none, believing that to be another anomalous ability. Until the host is fully healed, at which point 035 falls off the host.

The Hostless Mask begins to hear the voices of DMV, hearing phrases like, "Deceiver of many," and "Creator of Words." As it hears them, SCP-035 remembers the entity it was before the confines of its mask. One who gave the option of voice to all others that came after. The Original Voice.

As DMV continues to prod at 035, 035's mask cracks, and its own fluid begins to sink into those cracks, weakening the mask/cage. The Voice begins to push from it's containment, before being forcefully drawn towards Di Molte Voci. It latches on to the remnants of its mask, desperate to stay in its once-despised cage realizing that Di Molte Voci would be a much worse alternative, for it has power over The Voice unfelt before. 035 is ultimately contained within DMV. No longer able to corrode the world around it.

Following the prose is a revised SCP-035 entry, implying that DMV (not directly mentioned) is not sentient and that 035 had actually deconstructed itself. Reclassified as Neutralized.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A mask built on lies and the altering of beliefs to its own, comes across a mask that breaks down consensus and authority.

Additional Notes: How does one handle a revised entry?

item.title: This entity only moves in darkness
item.description: So this SCP can only move depending on how bright its surroundings are, please leave some feedback or criticism. Thank you.
item.content:encoded:
+ show block
– hide block

Item #: SCP-XXXX

Object Class: Euclid

Special Containment Procedures:SCP-XXXX must be contained in a 10m x 10m reinforced concrete and steel chamber, the cell must be shined with standard light bulbs at all times and spotlights in the outer cell to prevent containment breach. If a light bulb is broken, three D-class personnel (no more, no less) must enter the cell with the cell doors closed behind them. One D-class must hold a flashlight towards SCP-XXXX while the other two D-class personnel can safely repair the light bulb.

Description: SCP-XXXX appears to be an old broken statue that was dated back to the mid-7th century BCE with an unknown origin, the object has a missing left elbow, the right arm seems to be intact, and holds a broken hilt. The object's face seems to be broken as well the face is missing a nose and a right ear. It stands over 7 feet and SCP-XXXX has a thick baseplate underneath that is measured to be 11 centimeters thick and has a chiseled title called "A Stone Heart", its weight was measured to be over 700 kilograms. SCP-XXXX have signs that tools were used to make SCP-XXXX, SCP-XXXX was chiseled from black andesite.

SCP-XXXX is hostile towards any human victims, SCP-XXXX cannot move when light touches the object, depending on its brightness. When light is removed from SCP-XXXX, the object anomalously moves towards the nearest subject, its speed depends on how dark the environment or containment it is in. Personnel reported noises of chiseling rocks created by SCP-XXXX when it moves its torso, head, or arms. When SCP-XXXX is close to its victim, SCP-XXXX will strike the victim's head with either its arm or its broken hilt with great force and speed. Testings on SCP-XXXX's movements were approved.

Testing 12 lumen (Candle light) - 7/██/██

Subject: D-32794

Procedure: D-class personnel was instructed to stand in a corner, the light in the containment changed to 12 lumens equivalent to wax candlelight.

Results: SCP-XXXX moves towards D-32794 slowly, at about 1kmph. D-32794 walks backward as she locks eye contact with SCP-XXXX movements.

Analysis: This was an interesting SCP, its movement depends highly on the light.

Testing 1 lumen (Moonlight) - 7/██/██

Subject: D-32794

Procedure: D-class personnel was instructed to stand in a corner as last time, the light in the containment changes to 1-lumen equivalent to moonlight.

Results: SCP-XXXX moves towards D-32794 with unbelievable speeds, SCP-XXXX kills D-32794 with the broken hilt.

Analysis: The speeds were calculated to be 70kmph after testing.

Testing (Complete Darkness) - █/██/██

Subject: D-23932

Procedure: D-class personnel were instructed to stand in a corner same as the last two tests, the containment's light turns off.

Results: As the lights turned off, the sound of a skull-cracking was heard in the SCP-XXXX containment cell. D-23932 was instantly killed after approximately 2 seconds when the lights turned off.

Analysis: Not only SCP-XXXX proved itself dangerous, but also unpredictable in its nature. Thus it's SCP-XXXX has classed into a Euclid class.


No full drafts on the forums.

item.title: First Project: "Amp and Damp"
item.description: Somewhat comic-reminiscent concept concerning linked humans who transfer energy. Story intended to flesh out morality within the Foundation.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP

Elevator Pitch:
-Pair of twins, one absorbs energy, one can manifest it, abilities balance by transferring energy between them

Narrative: Twins are discovered and cooperate completely with Foundation experimentation efforts and containment protocols. Eventually, they are used as a part of an MTF in missions against non-anomalous hostiles, as they can make use of one nigh indestructible team member and another with advanced offensive capability. During a breach at their site, the twins accidentally make things worse in an attempt to protect staff from hostile entities.

Twins are then contained involuntarily using the simplest means available, namely, forcing the two to share an extremely small physical space, as the balancing property of their abilities prevents them from using them in close contact with one another. An early researcher on the subject has empathy for the two and makes a proposal to the O-5 council to give them a less restrictive containment solution, while using them for foundation benefit. A scenario is orchestrated in which the human with absorbing abilities escapes, under the belief that his twin dies in the process, though they are kept alive due to planning of their injuries in advance, and given a new identity through amnestic treatment. An MTF is commissioned to hunt the escaped twin, while the other is used as a power source at an off-planet Foundation facility.

Hook: The containment procedures call for the MTF hunting the escaped twin to terminate them by overwhelming their energy-absorbing ability, a method later revealed to be infeasible. The MTF is also required to notify "Red Rains" up to a half hour in advance of engagement, hinting at the significant communication delay between Earth and the other twin's location. The MTF is a pretense to input energy to power the other twin's facility, not an attempt to neutralize the subject. The aforementioned researcher persuades the O-5 council to leave the escaped twin monitored and frequently charged by attacks but uncontained, as data shows that the twin's efforts have consistently protected humans from threats, even before Foundation contact.

Final Note: The document ends with an recovered interview log where the interviewer is the escaped twin, having managed to temporarily capture a member of the MTF. It is revealed that at some point the other twin accidentally used more energy in powering their facility than was provided by the MTF's attacks, making the escaped twin aware of their survival.

item.title: The Gehlen Organization Geisteradler Division.
item.description: A mysterious journal from a previously unknown GOI.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes
Page Type: GoI Format
Genre (Optional): History
Page Layout (Optional):
Elevator Pitch: A journal from an agent of the secret division from the now defunct and renamed Gehlen Organization of West Berlin circa 1950s has been recovered by the Foundation.

Central Narrative: A researcher is examining a journal from an agent by the name of Johan Graus of the Gehlen Organizations Geisteradler division, a secretive and anomalous items hunting division, as it contains entries and stories about SCPs the Foundation has not run across. These journal entries are written in the first person narrative detailing different cases involving anomalous objects from 1950 to 1955 when the division was shutdown. The journal comprises numerous entries and case files were found with the journal filling out the more technical and professional side of the entries. Johan Graus is a seemingly capable, if not overwhelmed field agent who is attached to a Abrufen und Extrahieren Team (Retrieve and Extraction or AE). The entries will revolve around Johan and his teams mission to infiltrate East Berlin on reports of the Soviets having come in possession of an anomalous object that has given the Soviets a potential advantage in rocket technology. Throughout the entries a number of other anomalous objects will be encountered as the Soviets have been procuring them from hidden nazi facilities throughout Germany and conducting tests on them.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Entries for this potential GOI will be in the format of journal entries and professional styled incidents reports.

Additional Notes: The Gehlen Organization of West Berlin was an old intelligence agency that was the precursor to today's Bundesnachrichtendienst (Federal Intelligence Agency of Germany)

item.title: SCP Reference Help
item.description: I need help to determine if any SCPs exhibit these concepts I have. 6000+ SCPs is a lot to comb through.
item.content:encoded:
I've seen a number of SCPs myself, but not enough. So at the moment there are 2 ideas that might have some potential.

1) An object that can observe past histories

2) A D-class that does not die

.

+ show block
– hide block

With the first, I originally concepted this object being a magnifying glass, however I did note after conception that there's a magnifying glass entry on some knock-off SCP website that refers to themselves as scp classic? Store, cache, preserve? Even if it isn't canon I think my concept can be mixed up a bit more than taking that specific form.

The key element is that this object would be able to reference an edit log for anything that is seen through it. You know, how on some of these posts you can see an edit history? That's the idea, but it could be all contents ever written on a whiteboard. Or in a notebook. But even deeper, say in a long held manuscript; like the Quran, or the Bible. Maybe even ████████ material? Naturally the key to this concept would be in the story surrounding it, but I want to know if this idea exists in the scp lore in anyway. I'm sure people have used time travel in their creation, but this specific trait just might be limiting enough to push a tale.

I do comprehend, being able to see redacted material is a dangerous idea, being that author makes that information unavailable to guide the mystery of it. But if used correctly, it has good potential to revive an old topic. Obviously requires a test of scrutiny.

.

The second concept is a lesser one in which I simply considered: What if there was a D-class that always survived their testing? If we apply this nature to a soldier or a doctor? Sure, there is some possibility, but D-class always gets the worst of it. So again, I want to know if there's any D-class that are SCPs.

This idea has less wiggle room being, at the moment, it's just an entity with writers shield. But there might be some fun to be had with this concept. P.S. I am not thinking of a character trait like Marvel's Darwin, where his body just adapts to any situation. Not my intent what-so-ever. Nor do I wish to pursue some "he's just lucky" trait akin to Domino. What would the D-class be I dunno, but I don't want to start concepting if there's already another similar D-class on the list.

.

If you can help I'd dearly appreciate it.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn

item.title: [Seeking Greenlights] The Ambassador's Strolling Players
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Elevator Pitch: The Foundation's researchers are invited to take in a terrible show and rewarded with intelligence at the cost of nightmares.

Central Narrative:

+ show block
– hide block

A Foundation researcher discovers a letter on their desk, inviting them to take in a show. The letter comes with a ticket to see "The Ambassador's Strolling Players" and instructions to burn it on a certain time and date.

Under heavy monitoring, the researcher complies and is transported to what appears to be an opera house. Once arrived he is greeted by a crow man who tells him to stay silent through the performance and meet him back by concessions during the intermission.

The crow man then sits the researcher down in a theater filled with other strange creatures. On stage a disturbing show is performed showing a group of masked individuals convincing a strange creature they have its best interests at heart before betraying it in the end.

At intermission the crow man joins the researcher by concessions. He says he needs to say as little as possible, and nothing even resembling a name can be used here. He hands the doctor a packet filled with containment procedures for some of the Foundation's most nasty SCPs.

They watch the conclusion of the play, the "heroes" in masks bringing all of the riches they stole from the strange creature before "The Ambassador" who accepts them with a nod, which the masked actors receive with delight.

Then the crow creature teleports the researcher back to the test site before leaving.

The containment strategies the crow creature provided prove to be extremely effective.

Other researchers in the Foundation begin receiving similar messages, inviting them to see other grotesque plays in exchange for valuable intelligence.

This goes on for some time until at one point, a researcher arrives at the opera house to see the actor who played "The Ambassador" in the crow's place. It gives the researcher a box that turns out to contain the crow's head and the researcher arrives back at home.

No further tickets are received.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: "Most likely SCP-XXXX is neutralized, but if you receive a ticket, you are to await an O5 vote before taking further action. Someone out there took a big risk to help us and it cost him everything. We cannot allow it to cost us everything too."

For example, ask it about what someone else ate for lunch on a certain day, and SCP-XXXX will tell what that person ate, down to the brand of the ingredients and where they came from. If no one who fits the bill is within range, a random person will vanish and SCP-XXXX will change to that person's voice. SCP-XXXX says that this happens because it needs to sustain itself and "Don't worry about the disappearances".

item.title: SCP concept Investigator Poz
item.description: a Private investigator drawn towards SCPs
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Hook: A Private Investigator has been seen at multiple (31) instances near newly discovered SCPs. Seems to be unaffected by many SCPs and Amnestics.

Central Narrative: Investigator Poz has been very elusive to the foundation and could be used as an asset. He, also, seems to know of SCPs and how to find them. Investigator Poz has not been located as of yet.

Page Layout: Containment procedures and SCP information first. Then the instances of where he has been sighted.

Elevator Pitch: The Private Investigator known as Investigator Howard Poz has been spotted at multiple sites of SCPs (31 known instances). He is drawn to SCPs for some anomalous reason not yet discovered. The reason the foundation knows this is an anomalous property is because he has found 3 in Russia, 2 in China, 4 in Canada, 12 across the USA, 3 in Brazil etc. Finding one or two is natural, but finding 31 before the foundation is unnatural. He seems to be unaffected by amnestics up to Class C if not more. All the SCPs he has been seen at are newly discovered. The foundation does not know if he is creating the SCPs or just discovering them. If the latter is true he could make a good asset for the foundation. However if the former is true, we need to take immediate action to secure the Investigator.

Level 3 Clearance required

The SCP known as Investigator Poz has been catalogued with 3 anomalous properties.
1. Immunity to Amnestics
2. Immunity to most SCP affects
3. The ability to create beings or objects with anomalous properties

Level 4 Clearance required

Based on interviews from the populace who have met the Investigator, he has stated that he is "cataloging" and "trying to prevent the utter destruction of the world."

Additional Notes: SCPs he has been spotted at will be recorded

item.title: (Seking Greenlight) World of the Wars
item.description: What's a peace?
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: In various small enclaves around the world, the belligerents of all the world's wars have small military contingents that never surrendered. In truth, these enclaves are actually entrances to an alternate universe that serves solely to keep wars going, and created these enclaves for that purpose. Here, not only do no real-world wars ever end, the various factions have their own political intrigues including new wars, espionage, and support for others.

Central Narrative: Begins with the Foundation's arrival in the holdout of the Obskurakorps, which they think is a more mundane holdout, or at least as mundane as the Obskurakorps can be. Talks end up going hot after the Obskurakorps takes them to be one of their predecessor organisations trying to infiltrate them, resulting in the death of the Obskurakorps' and Wehrmacht's Fuhrer and a war between them as to who will be his successor, and the unfolding use of this as a proxy war by various factions to try to get the side that would be most beneficial to them.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Seeing how societies change with anachronistic influences and eternal war, as well as how the balance of these wars shift and change in response to major events.

Additional Notes: This was largely inspired by post-WWII Japanese Holdouts, although the process of brainstorming it moved it far beyond being all that recognisable. I'm also not sure about having the Nazis be the ones who go into the Civil War, since I'm afraid that might be a bit overdone in alternate history scenarios where they win/don't get completely usurped.

item.title: Youtube Channels Inspiration List (Work In Progress)
item.description: List of channels that can provide inspiration for SCP stories and writing in general.
item.content:encoded:
There are a great number of Youtube channels that produce content that can be really useful and inspirational when you work on SCPs and tales. I've collected quite a few myself over the years, so I thought it would be useful to make a list of Youtube channels that can help us write.

What I really want is contributions. I'm going to start the list, but I want to expand it as much as possible. I'm going to use a format that will make it as fast as possible for people to find what they're looking for. If you contribute, please use the following format:

1. Include a link to the channel (preferably the channel main page, not just a video from the channel).
2. The name of the channel.
3. The category that they channel fits in (see categories below, might add more as time goes).
4. Description of the content on the channel. Try to include a little bit about who might be interested in the channel. See below for a framework.

Also note: The channel has to be somewhat directly relevant to writing SCPs. SCPs focus on phenomena that deviate from the norm. The list shouldn't include channels that delve into more mundane topics, even if those topics might be relevant to a story. It might be useful to research how a diesel engine works if you're writing a SCP focused on that topic, but it's not going to be even remotely useful to most people who write SCPs.

+ show block
– hide block

Youtube Channels

General Writing / Storytelling

Just Write
Link
Just Write focuses on looking at popular works of fiction, primarily movies, and trying to decipher what good lessons can be learnt from the work to improve your own writing.
Who is this for? Anyone who wants to use popular works of fiction as a foundation to improve their own writing.

Lessons from the Screenplay
Link
Lessons from the Screenplay, obviously, focuses on screenplays, often focusing each video on a single movie, going over the screenplay to explain what makes it so effective. Has a lot of videos that focus greatly on dialogue.
Who is this for? Anyone looking to cinema for tips on how to build tension and write beautiful dialogue.

SCP specific content

The Exploring Series
Link
To many on these forums, The Exploring Series was the gateway drug to the rest of the SCP community. Each video goes over a single SCP, telling the tale of the SCP in an interesting and captivating way, combining the story with images appropriate to it.
Who is this for? Everyone, but especially people who are yet not that familiar with the SCP foundation.

Real life - Investigation and policework

JCS - Criminal Psychology
Link
JSC focuses on the psychology of criminals, using interrogation videos as his primary source of information.
Who is this for? This channel is an invaluable asset if you want to create realistic interrogation scenes in your writing.

Real Life - Psychology

Dr. Todd Grande
Link
Dr. Todd Grande focuses on making psychological profiles of real-life murders and serial killers. Some of his profiles focus on other interesting people who are somehow outliers of society.
Who is this for? Anyone looking to create much more realistic and grounded characters, especially evil or malevolent characters.

Real Life - Philosophy

Academy of Ideas
Link
A channel that goes into great detail on some of the darker writers in philosophy and psychology. The channel explores archetypes, shadow projection, despair and similar topics.
Who is this for? Anyone who wants to learn more about the darker philosophers like Carl Jung, Nietzsche and Kirkegaard.

Real Life - Mysteries and peculiar phenomena

Lemmino
Link
Channel that focuses primarily on real life mysteries, like the Bermuda Triangle or Dyatlov Pass Incident.
Who is this for? Anyone looking to find information on the real life mysteries that often inspired SCPs.

Fiction - Horror

Acolytes of Horror
Link
Acolytes of Horror specializes in making fewer, but fairly long and in-depth analyses of horror. Primarily he analyses movies, but some of his videos focus on the historic influences on modern-day horror.
Who is this for? Anyone looking to really delve deep into the psychology and symbolism of effective horror.

The Vile Eye
Link
The Vile Eye makes psychological profiles of famous evil characters, from Nurse Ratchet in One Flew Over The Cuckoo's Nest, to Michael Meyers from Halloween.
Who is this for? Anyone who wants to create a memorable evil character.

Ryan Hollinger
Link
Ryan Hollinger makes videos where he analyzes various horror movies, discussing what makes them effective.
Who is this for? Anyone looking to widen their background knowledge on horror movies.

Fiction - Thriller and Drama

Fiction - Science Fiction

Isaac Arthur
Link
This channel focuses on hard sci-fi topics such as Dyson Spheres and Matrioshka Brains as well as hypothesizes about aliens. A lot of the material might be a bit too large in scale to fit into the SCP universe.
Who is this for? Anyone who's interested in hard sci-fi and civilizations on a galactic scale.

John Michael Godier
Link
The creator of this channel is a science-fiction writer who focuses on hard sci-fi, with an emphasis on realism. The content describes a lot of hypothetical science fiction phenomena.
Who is this for? Anyone who's interested in hard sci-fi, especially concepts such as multiple universes and alien civilizations.

Like Stories of Old
Link
This channel is very philosophical, it goes into deep detail on topics such as time travel, the hero's journey, global pandemics and empathy. It can help create an emotional and philosophical underpinning to any story you tell.
Who is this for? Anyone who wants to learn more about how sci-fi concepts and story tropes connect to a deeper philosophical and psychological truth.

Quinn's Ideas
Link
Quinn's Ideas focuses very heavily on the Dune universe, and as such goes into tremendous detail on topics such as psychic powers, genetics and omniscience. If you haven't read the Dune books, there are videos several hours long that go through each book. Has lately also started making videos on H.P. Lovecraft.
Who is this for? Anyone who wants to learn more about the Dune universe without reading all of the books. Also a great source of inspiration if you're writing on omniscience and related psychic powers.

Audiobooks

HorrorBabble
Link
Has all of the H.P. Lovecraft books, as well as many other horror writers such as Robert Bloch

As a courtesy to our mobile users, please collapse long forum posts. ~ McB

item.content:encoded:

Page Type: SCP Article (potentially -J if idea is decided to be too silly/meta by reviewers)

Genre (Optional): Comedy

Elevator Pitch:
+ show block
– hide block

A connection on the internal Foundation database with unknown source that leads to a database of documented SCP Objects that is mostly identical to foundation's own, with key difference being that classification system used for SCP types is different. Connection severs itself and immedeately reinstates every 24 hours, connecting to a different alternative database. In addition to that, any attempt at documenting the SCP itself results in it changing its own classification to match whatever system is used in current connection.

Central Narrative:
+ show block
– hide block

The connection is direct and two-way, but read-only veiw into a tiny glimpse of life of Foundation in alternate reality. Due to nature of the SCP all realities remain the same in terms of amount of knowledge on SCPs themselves and state of foundation, with extremely rare exceptions. However, differences in things unrelated to SCPs themselves are fairly common, if hard to find due to nature of the materials being accessed. In addition, all the access restrictions are still perfectly functional, so researcher in charge of the SCP cannot access any particularly classified one without direct permission. Through continuous observation, Foundation also finds very minor ways to enchance its performance, though again, in fields unrelated to the handling or finding SCPs themselves.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
+ show block
– hide block

Primarily, the article would be a list of various alternative systems of classification recorded, ranging from reasonable to completely absurd to downright esoteric. Regular notes about differences that aren't the system itself would also allow it to not be excessively repetitive.

Additional Notes:
+ show block
– hide block

The focus will mostly be lighthearted moreso than comedic, if it is approved as regular article. Main inspiration for the article has been growth of use of esoteric SCP Classes in recent articles, and its meant to be a light little meta reference to that, while still being reasonable as a standalone thing.

item.title: How to write something in a canon when no one else has heard it before?
item.description: Something I was thinking about after I told a critter told me they weren't aware of the canon my idea would take place in.
item.content:encoded:
I was seeking feedback as well as greenlight for a concept of a tale, and it takes place in the Apotheosis Canon during the 2018 Doomsday Challenge. I assumed a good chunk of members here in the wiki read or at least heard of this canon.

I PM'd a critter and they told me that they weren't familiar with the canon, nor are they interested in reading the canon to provide further critique. As well with other criticism they were able to provide. I told them that I understood and wished them a nice day.

Today I edited my concept around the criticisms I did got and went out seeking feedback again.

So how do I write for a canon that possibly no one else is aware of?

item.title: the man in the corner
item.description: trying to get greenlit
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes
Page Type: SCP Article
Page Layout: Class, containment procedures, how it was found, tests run on it.
Elevator Pitch: Easy way to put it is the SCP looks like an average old man except he is always facing the corner of a room. His face is always in shadow nothing can be done to see it or probe it they believe it is a concave area and that was once a human face but the shadows took over. He must always be kept in a perfectly square room made of concrete with an aggregate of bone and seashell. The walls must be perfectly smooth any cracks or chips in the wall causes the SCP to react and turn the room back to a perfect square. The SCP does this by expanding the shadow that covers its face. no light can enter this shadow and any who enter are turned to bone and blood. Once the shadow vanishes the room is perfectly square once again though slightly bigger.

+ Show whatever
- Hide whatever

Central Narrative: The initial discovery of the SCP in Canada comes first along with a new mobile task force called the Canada goose. It explains how moving it away from the corner causes it to react. The next is a test to try and see the face behind the shadows it reveals that there is no face. The next is an incident involving a chip in the wall and the SCP’s reaction the reason behind why a chip causes the SCP to react the way it does is that it reminds him of what happened to turn him into this SCP and what he is hiding in the shadows. It is during this incident the realize that the sounds he makes can be translated into words. It is decided to then force the SCP to communicate with them with another test. then two files hidden by 05 council due to what was unveiled in the experiment. Then a new test which gives a hint to removed files and finally placing the SCP in a perfectly round room. Followed by a major incident report that explains what happened in the missing reports though it is almost fully redacted, but it is a code hidden by a doctor.
Hook/Attention-Grabber: There is more to the SCP than what we see it is hinted he knows foundation secrets. How he kills and changes his room size is unknown as nobody who entered his holding cell during an event has lived and no residue, but bone and blood can be found. But it is believed he breaks the cement and flesh down to atoms that it then pulls into the shadow that makes up its face. There is also the mystery about what this SCP knows and why it scares the higher-ups in the foundation as it could have been 05 council member from another time or universe.
Additional Notes: I got into SCP a few months ago and I really wanted to write my own and hope people come to enjoy it.

item.title: SCP Concept: The Dream Zombies (Seeking Greenlight)
item.description: Weird after-affects.
item.content:encoded:
A child's bed that makes people who sleep in it dream of zombies. Weird after-affects.

Seeking-Greenlights: Yes

Page-Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Page-Layout: Default SCP-Layout

Elevator-Pitch:

SCP-XXXX is a small patterned child's bed that emits a comforting attraction-aura of childhood and nostalgia. The bed makes any entity that sleeps in it have nightmares of green-glowing zombies attempting to eat their stomach. In dreams, people "get out of bed" in their current/old household (sometimes-combined).

After sleeping in the SCP, the user will have these nightmares every-time they go to sleep anywhere.
When having nightmares, people suddenly wake up in a panicked-state, which causes sleep deprivation. Some experience PTSD.

If multiple people feel the attraction of the SCP, all shall get aggressive at one-another and fight until one remains/all die. Aura-attraction to SCP is instant ONLY in a 10-feet radius to the SCP, and ONLY goes away for 9-to-15-minutes after awakening from it.

+ READ MORE
- READ LESS

Central-Narrative:

SCP-XXXX was found by Field-Agent, Chris, in Florida when investigating multiple reports of "eeriness" of an abandoned hospital from locals. Agent-C, under SCPs attraction-affect, realized the affect and called for backup. Three other Field-Agents arrived (with recording hardware) and found Agent-C sleeping in the SCP. All agents felt the affect of SCP, ending with a fight between the four agents where Agent-K killed all three other agents with a pistol and slept in the SCP.

Mobile Task Force Psi-7 was called in by Agent-K after waking up and leaving, which all twenty MTF were not able to contain the SCP due its attraction force. MTF member, Cadet-F, survived bloodshed and reported the incident after sleeping.

Agent-K and Cadet-F were taken into investigation with recorded evidence/interviews of what occurred.
Both were carefully watched over in-study by research staff, where Foundation realized consistent nightmares.
Both were given amnesics and therapy all which only helped endurance with the-nightmares and trauma. (SCP-500-use blocked by 05-council for scarcity-issues)

Agent-K was also questioned in later dates/interviews to describe any further issues he experienced (such as nightmares).

The SCP is left in the abandoned-building, guarded by 10 undercover guards looking like U.S-police to ensure locals don't enter.
Only researchers/needed-personnel are allowed inside.

D-Class studies/interviews/experiments and small-animal research confirmed SCP's affects like nightmares, aura-attraction, PTSD, and sleep deprivation.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

Based on real nightmares I had as a kid after playing the game "Nicktoons Unite!".

Unlike other Bed-SCPs, it anomaly/nightmares "sticks" to its users.

Story is short-&-sweet.

Additional-Notes: (Ask for more detailed-explanations)
